blog_summary: Adrian Colyer reflects on the end of a term of The Morning Paper, summarizing 50 papers reviewed over the past few months. He highlights personal favorites from the term, including works on distributed systems, machine learning, software engineering, and data management. The selection showcases a diverse range of topics, from YouTube's analytical data serving (Procella) to neural network memorization (The Secret-Sharer) and interpretable ML models. Colyer expresses enthusiasm for the learning journey and looks forward to resuming with new insights in the new year.
